evals.prompt: Create a motion system with timing tiers, easing curves, and reduced-motion alternates for UI transitions.
assertions: Defines at least 3 duration tiers and when to use each.
Defines easing guidance without relying on bouncy/overshoot defaults.
Provides reduced-motion alternates for every major pattern.
Mentions keyboard/touch parity for hover-driven affordances.
Avoids motion that blocks critical content or navigation.
